questions.question_text: When answering a video interview question about your motivation for joining the Fast Stream, what is the best strategy?
options: Memorize a script word-for-word
Focus on how the programme aligns with your desire to tackle real issues and give back to communities
Discuss only the financial benefits and pension
Give a very brief 'yes' or 'no' answer to save time
questions.explanation: The programme looks for candidates who share the Civil Service goal of serving the public and addressing significant national challenges.

questions.question_text: During an assessment centre group exercise, what behavior demonstrates high leadership potential?
options: Talking over others to ensure your point is heard
Actively listening to others and facilitating a consensus to achieve the group's goal
Remaining silent to avoid making mistakes
Criticizing the ideas of others to show yours are better
questions.explanation: Leadership in the Civil Service is about collaboration, inclusivity, and ensuring the collective goal is met efficiently.

questions.question_text: What is the best strategy for answering a motivation question in a video interview?
options: Give a rehearsed speech about why the salary is attractive.
Focus on your personal desire to tackle real issues and contribute to the Civil Service values.
List every single accomplishment you have ever achieved since high school.
Avoid mentioning the specific programme to keep your answer general.
questions.explanation: Successful candidates show they understand the purpose of the Civil Service and how their own values align with it.

questions.question_text: In a group assessment, if a teammate suggests an idea you disagree with, what should you do?
options: Tell them the idea is bad and ignore it.
Politely point out potential risks and suggest an alternative or a compromise.
Stay silent and hope the group chooses your idea instead.
Agree with them immediately to avoid any conflict.
questions.explanation: Showing you can constructively challenge ideas and work toward a consensus is a vital sign of leadership.

questions.question_text: What does 'professionalism' look like during a video interview?
options: Wearing formal clothes, having a tidy background, and clear, structured communication.
Wearing casual clothes to show you are relaxed and confident.
Keeping the camera off to prevent technical issues.
Reading directly from notes to ensure you don't forget anything.
questions.explanation: First impressions matter; showing effort in your presentation and preparation demonstrates your commitment.

questions.question_text: Why is time management critical during an assessment centre group task?
options: Because you get extra marks for finishing early.
To ensure the group meets the objectives and provides a comprehensive response within the time limit.
So that you have time to check your phone before the next task.
To force the group to choose the first idea that comes to mind.
questions.explanation: Effective leaders guide their group to manage time well so that all requirements of the task are met.

questions.question_text: If you are asked about a time you showed 'integrity' in an interview, what should you highlight?
options: A time you achieved a goal at any cost.
A situation where you did the right thing even though it was difficult or unpopular.
A time you took credit for work that the team did.
A situation where you kept a secret to protect a friend.
questions.explanation: Integrity is about adhering to ethical principles and honesty, especially in challenging circumstances.

questions.question_text: How do you prepare for an assessment centre?
options: Do nothing and hope for the best
Research the organization, practice typical exercises, and be ready to reflect on your experiences
Memorize the entire website
Buy a new suit and nothing else
questions.explanation: Good preparation builds confidence and demonstrates serious commitment to the role.

questions.question_text: What should you do if you don't understand a question in an interview?
options: Guess the answer
Politely ask the interviewer to rephrase or clarify
Sit in silence
Tell them the question is wrong
questions.explanation: Asking for clarification shows that you are thoughtful and want to provide a relevant, accurate response.

questions.question_text: When discussing your skills in an interview, what is the 'STAR' method?
options: State, Talk, Action, Results
Situation, Task, Action, Result
Situation, Training, Achievement, Review
Strategy, Time, Ability, Readiness
questions.explanation: The STAR method is a structured, proven way to provide clear and concise examples of your behavioral skills.

questions.question_text: In a group assessment, why is it important to include quieter team members?
options: Because it is a requirement to pass
To gain a wider range of ideas and ensure everyone is fully engaged and heard
So they do all the work
To make yourself look better
questions.explanation: Diverse input leads to better decisions and is a key trait of an inclusive leader.
